name: Complex

source.code:
/-- Complex numbers consist of two `Real`s: a real part `re` and an imaginary part `im`. -/
structure Complex : Type where
  /-- The real part of a complex number. -/
  re : ℝ
  /-- The imaginary part of a complex number. -/
  im : ℝ
